data.gender_notes: Hanash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-n-sh', meaning 'to be gentle, to be graceful, to be soft'. In Islamic history, Hanash is a name given to those who possess these qualities and are revered for their gentle demeanor and graceful actions. The name Hanash carries the meaning “Graceful, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanash usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
